correctness.rationale: The weighted K_{k,n-k} Kirchhoff cofactor has determinant m^(k-1)(sum_A x_a)^(m-1) product_A x_a, including k=1 and m=1 boundaries; its root-weight z specializes to m^(k-1)z(k-1+z)^(m-1), recovering the full joint distribution. Conditional adjacent mass ratios (n-k-d)/(d(k-1)) strictly decrease with k and supports nest, establishing reverse TP2 including zero cells. Direct symmetry q(k)=n P(B=k)/(2k) gives Cov(B,D)=-4(n-1)V/n^2. Contat Theorems 1–2 (original PDF) supply class-size CLT and near-symmetry Pr(epsilon=1)->1/4, yielding V/n->1/16 and covariance -1/4; conditional PGFs tend to z exp(z-1) on central bands, giving joint weak independence. Independent enumeration of all Prüfer strings through n=6 recovered every joint cell. Finite checks alone do not establish n-uniform claims.
residual_risks: Asymptotic marginal CLT and near-symmetry are imported from Contat, not independently reproved.
